Name: SF - Cave of Memories
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/nGhT2YJ.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Cave of Memories is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url] pack which adds a building that contains a mysterious mirror, one that is able to replay certain events.


[img]https://imgur.com/bzPzvAf.gif[/img]


[img]https://imgur.com/auC2p9O.png[/img]
[b][size=5]Build Cost[/size][/b]
[size=3]The cave requires the following resources to be built:[/size]
[/size][list]
[size=3][*][b]Neptunite [/b]x1
[*][b]Gold Bar[/b] x10
[*][b]Stone [/b]x 500
[*][b]Coins [/b]x50000
[/size][/list][size=3]

[b][size=5]Using the Mirror[/size][/b]
[size=3]To use the mirror and replay certain events, simply approach and right click it. You'll be prompted with a menu to select which character and memory you would like to reply.[/size]

Characters you haven't met yet will be blanked out, while characters you have met but don't have any events for will be greyed out.

[img]https://imgur.com/Lma5PW5.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/fP5yPeU.png[/img]
[b][size=3]How do I build this?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Visit the Wizard's Tower and utilize the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Wizard's_Tower#Buildings]buildings book[/url]﻿ to construct it.[/size]
[*][size=3]You can utilize the wizard's building menu after getting the [spoiler][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Magic_Ink]Magic Ink[/url][/spoiler][/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Can I build more than one cave?[/size][/b]
[/size][list]
[size=3][/size][*][size=3]The Cave of Memories can only be built once per player. If deconstructed, you may build it again.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Does this work with modded NPC events?[/size][/b]
[list]
[size=3][/size][*][size=3]This mod should work for most heart events, but if there are issues please do report them.[/size]
[/list]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/MysticalBuildings/tree/standalone/cave-of-memories]available here[/url]﻿.
